description: Native (no-LiteLLM) per-row text generation with Google Gemini text models. Drop-in peer of openai_llm / anthropic_llm — same field shape so providers swap by changing `type:` and the api_key env var. For multi-vendor workflows use litellm_inference_asset.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame with an added text-response column (and an _error column on failed rows).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream DataFrame asset — one row per Gemini call

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the API key (falls back to GOOGLE_API_KEY)

text_model.label: Text Model
text_model.description: Gemini text model id (gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.0-flash-lite, gemini-flash-latest, etc.)

system_prompt.description: System instruction sent on every call (Gemini 'system_instruction').
system_prompt.label: System Prompt

user_prompt_template.label: User Prompt Template
user_prompt_template.description: Static template with {column} placeholders. Set this OR input_column.

input_column.label: Input Column
input_column.description: Column whose value becomes the per-row prompt. Set this OR user_prompt_template.

output_column.label: Output Column
output_column.description: Column for the model's text response

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

thinking_budget.label: Thinking Budget
thinking_budget.description: Tokens reserved for internal reasoning on Gemini 2.5+ thinking models. max_output_tokens is the budget for thinking + visible output combined; if thinking burns most of it, the visible response gets truncated. Set to 0 to disable thinking entirely (recommended for short, structured outputs like one-sentence summaries or labels). Leave unset to let the model decide.

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: Gemini LLM
